description: Inventory service gradual RSS growth with open file descriptor accumulation

mocked_llm_hypotheses.description: Memory leak via unclosed file handles causing RSS and FD accumulation

evidence.observation: RSS grew from 800MB to 4.2GB without restart
Open FDs grew from 120 to 9800 — strong indicator of handle leak

mocked_llm_hypotheses.reasoning: Co-occurring RSS growth and FD count growth strongly suggests a resource leak where file handles and their associated buffers are not being closed.

mocked_llm_hypotheses.description: Traffic spike causing temporary resource pressure

evidence.observation: High FDs could indicate many concurrent request handlers

mocked_llm_hypotheses.reasoning: High traffic could briefly increase both memory and open connections.
